caseName: Kaipu ex rel. Kaipu v. Pinkham
caseNameFull: Emma L. Kaipu in behalf of Mikala Kaipu v. L. E. Pinkham, President of the Board of Health, etc.
attorneys: Mr. A. G. M. Robertson for appellant., Mr. Lórrin Andrews for appellee.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Territory of Hawaii.

Death of Mikala Kaipu having been suggested, and the case abated,, appeal dismissed.
